changes.reason: Generated Lambda packaging reuses the invoking pnpm CLI or the installed PATH executable without Corepack, retaining build-before-replacement ordering and subprocess failure propagation. This is build-time Tooling; no application Host support claim changes.

kubernetes.reason: The change executes pnpm on the build machine for the Lambda packaging script. It adds no Kubernetes Node Host provider, cluster storage or application lifecycle requirement.
constraints: Subprocess fixtures verify local packaging order and failure propagation; they do not verify live infrastructure, provider certification or a Windows host.

aws-lambda.reason: The generated packaging script runs before deployment on the build machine, not inside a Lambda invocation. It reuses pnpm to build and stage the existing Lambda Host dependency closure. Invocation scope, telemetry flush, IAM and runtime capabilities are unchanged.
constraints: Subprocess fixtures verify local packaging order and failure propagation; they do not verify live infrastructure, provider certification or a Windows host.

cloudflare.reason: The Lambda packaging script is not emitted for or executed by Workers. This build-time command introduces no Workers binding, storage capability, isolate lifecycle or Node Container requirement.
constraints: Subprocess fixtures verify local packaging order and failure propagation; they do not verify live infrastructure, provider certification or a Windows host.
